description: Free: creates the voice draft and returns Ania’s recording page (valid 7 days) to show the person whose voice it is. On that page THEY give consent (you cannot) and read the sentences one by one; they can stop and come back. Payment only later, with train_voice.

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.

voice_language.description: Language the person will read and the voice will speak: pt-BR or en-US.

voice_name.description: A short name for the voice (e.g. "Voz do Alan").

name: create_voice
title: Start a custom voice
